In the 100 Yards Sprint Handicap there were six heats, although owing to absentees, some were sparsely filled. Heat winners were—D.

Dick Negus ran well in the Junior 100, while Dicky Dumbrill took second place in the Senior event, and also won the 220 Yards race. D. Cook did well to gain second place in the Junior 220, and Alf Orton showed something like his old form in winning the 880 Yards event.
